endpoints.notes: Reads library.json summary and current index pointer; does not enumerate videos.
Small Admin settings file used for shell and route controls.
In-memory supervisor state; safe for shell status.
Machine-readable route loading contract for Admin web.
Route-owned paged source-video list. Ready rows use the transcript index; non-ready status filters use source-video-status-read-model-v1.
Single selected source-video detail and transcript summary.
Preprocess route list. The default limit is bounded by source-video-status-read-model-v1 instead of a hidden manifest sweep.
Bounded preprocess process-history report from complete admin.sqlite snapshots. It must not enumerate preprocess-job files from a page request.
No-scan readiness diagnostic explaining whether admin.sqlite has a complete preprocess-job snapshot for process-history rows.
Diagnostic read-model freshness endpoint. It reports state without forcing a rebuild.
Diagnostic status for the explicit background read-model reconciler. It never starts a scan.
Protection Center aggregate for release gates, read-model freshness, data-loading strategy, and ready protection.
Admin operation log tail from a bounded NDJSON file. It must not enumerate source-video manifests.
Read-only restore preflight for one command snapshot. It inspects only the selected snapshot manifest and captured files; it does not execute restore.
Guarded command-snapshot restore execution for one selected snapshot. It recomputes the restore plan and must never run as part of route or shell loading.
Recent runtime endpoint diagnostics from a bounded derived history file; it must not enumerate source-video manifests.
Paged and cached index-version list; current version remains visible even when outside the first page.
Supplemental dashboard metrics. Shell must remain usable when this endpoint is slow. Response includes per-section sources for admin-read-model/current-index/usage-events provenance.
Route-owned user-management table; do not prefetch from dashboard shell.
Doctor route report only; full checks are not a shell dependency.
Settings route path availability checks; reports configured paths without source-video enumeration.
Settings route runtime probe; not loaded during dashboard shell.
Explicit scan planning command. It is never a page-open side effect.
Explicit scan apply command protected by scan-preview and ready blockers.
Explicit background maintenance command. It rebuilds admin.sqlite from a validated manifest snapshot and is never a page-open side effect.
Explicit cancel request for the background read-model reconciler. It does not scan the library and only stops at safe checkpoints.

result.summary: Local Docker MVP smoke passed. This validates the local candidate shape only; Docker upload remains blocked until NAS/staging release gates pass.

run_instructions: The smoke builds local-only images, starts an isolated local compose stack, probes admin-web and /api/admin/* through nginx, collects admin-worker env, then runs docker compose down.
Do not use this as NAS live evidence. NAS release still needs live-readonly, worker-env proof, Cutter compatibility proof, disk gate, and rollback/staging approval.
